reason: Repository evidence shows a DeepSeek Harness plugin focused on user-facing image creation workflows: it provides image-generate and image-edit tools, supports OpenAI-compatible and Gemini backends, supports configurable multi-service setup and failover, and saves results as media with JSON sidecars, making media-tools the primary category.

summaries.zh: DSH Image Tools 是一款 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体插件，在对话中可使用 OpenAI 兼容接口与 Gemini 进行图片生成与编辑，并可按配置管理多个服务并保存输出。
summaries.en: DSH Image Tools is a DeepSeek Harness media plugin for generating and editing images from chat using OpenAI-compatible and Gemini services, with configurable multi-service setup and saved outputs.

capabilities: Calls external image APIs for generation and editing
Accepts and forwards user prompts, sizes, ratios, and format options
Reads local session files as image references for editing
Writes generated images and metadata sidecar files under outputs/images
Stores provider credentials through DSH credentials handling
